storyCards.headline: Mexican Radio: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Wall Of Voodoo's "Mexican Radio" reached #58 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Mexican Radio" is a song by American rock band Wall of Voodoo.

The track was initially released on their second studio album Call of the West (1982).

The video for the single was regularly featured on MTV in the United States, contributing to the song's popularity.

The song peaked at #58 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #58 on the Hot 100.
